title: Relationship Credit Against the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Refinance Down Payment
content:
**Relationship credit.** A customer refinancing the balloon of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract who keeps other Kestrel accounts current has a credit taken off the refinance down payment. The lines counted are the **Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract**, the **Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract** and the **Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**; a line counts when the customer holds an active account in it showing 0 days past due.

| Lines with an active account at 0 days past due | Taken off the refinance down payment |
|---|---|
| Two or three | USD 250.00 |
| Exactly one | USD 150.00 |
| None | None |

The records read are the status and days past due of the customer's accounts in those three lines.

*Hypothetical:* an active new-vehicle retail contract at 0 days past due and a paid-in-full pre-owned contract: one line, USD 150.00.
